solution_steps: Set Book of Taiyou and Penguin Soldier on the field.
Activate Hane-Hane's effect by flip summoning. Return one of Exodia's limbs or Exodia, the Forbidden One to your hand.
Activate Book of Taiyou, flip Penguin Soldier face up with its effect. Send the remaining two pieces of Exodia back to your hand.
